roles.heroLead: Plateau bathrooms work hard — two kids brushing teeth over one floor, muddy cleats in the hall bath, a master shower running twice a day. Tile handles that life only if the layer nobody sees is right, because tile and grout themselves are not waterproof. We build the bonded assembly, leave it under water for a documented 24 hours, photograph the proof, and then start setting.

roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Sammamish, WA?
roles.costP1: Sammamish tile installs price out at $14–$26 per square foot all-in — tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor together, with labor starting from $11/sq ft on its own. Tub-shower surrounds typically run $3,200–$6,800; a floor-plus-shower-plus-niche bathroom mostly settles between $6,500 and $14,000.
roles.costP2: The plateau surprise: what a tile costs per box predicts less than what shape it comes in. A modest mosaic sheet can eat more labor than a premium large-format plank — installers charge for the cutting and the joints, and mosaics multiply both.
roles.costNote: Current Sammamish ranges as of August 2026, covering tile plus materials plus labor. Treat these as planning numbers; the free in-home estimate produces the real one in writing.
roles.layersLead: Count up from the framing and a shower is seven layers before you reach grout. When a plateau shower fails early, the autopsy always finds a missing layer — the membrane most often, skipped once to save a few hundred dollars and repaid later at fifty times that.
roles.whyP1: No shower leak ever knocks on the door. It works quietly — through the grout, into the substrate — until a kid asks why the hallway floor feels soft or a stain blooms on the family-room ceiling. The invoice at that stage covers framing, subfloor, drywall and tiling the whole thing again.
roles.whyP2: Call waterproofing a tenth of the shower's cost. On a busy family shower, deleting that tenth is the priciest savings you will ever be offered.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Sammamish, WA?
roles.faqA1: All-in tile installation in Sammamish lands around $14 to $26 per square foot — that covers tile, setting materials, prep and labor, and labor starts at $11 per square foot by itself. Expect $3,200 to $6,800 for a standard tub-shower surround; a complete bathroom including floor, shower and niche generally comes to $6,500 to $14,000. Watch the format: mosaic sheets and oversized planks both cost meaningfully more per foot to set than ordinary 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Sammamish?
roles.faqA2: A standard alcove shower in Sammamish prices between $3,200 and $6,800, with demolition, bonded waterproofing, the pre-sloped pan, setting, a niche and grout inside the figure. Add benches, curbless entries, steam or floor-to-ceiling stone and it climbs. The waterproofing itself is around ten percent of the job — cheap insurance against the one failure that costs tens of thousands.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Without exception. Cement board alone is not waterproofing — our showers get a bonded membrane system: pre-sloped base, sheet or liquid membrane run up the walls, corners and pipe penetrations sealed to TCNA / ANSI A118.10 practice, then a 24-hour flood test that we photograph before any tile is set. Grout only slows water down; the membrane is what stops it reaching your framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Most Sammamish bathrooms run four to six working days: day one is demolition and dust control, day two builds substrate and waterproofing and starts the overnight flood test, setting takes one to two days after the test clears, and grout, silicone and trim close it out. Give the shower another 24 hours of cure before anyone uses it. Standalone floors: one to two days.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Family floors and showers want porcelain — under 0.5% water absorption, denser body, far harder to chip when something gets dropped. Ceramic is the economical pick for walls and backsplash duty. In Sammamish homes we default to porcelain anywhere feet or water go, and let ceramic and glass fight over the walls.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Gladly — figure $11 to $16 per square foot installed for an electric radiant mat, thermostat included. It rides on an uncoupling membrane, gets a resistance test before setting and another after, and takes its own circuit. It is the plateau's favorite school-morning luxury, and it only pencils out while the floor is already torn up.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Nine times out of ten, yes. Demo with haul-away runs about $3.50 per square foot, and it is the only way to inspect the subfloor for rot or movement and to keep the new floor height sane at doorways. Going over existing tile occasionally works on a truly flat, solidly bonded floor — but it hides exactly the problems we would rather meet at demolition than after grout day.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Sammamish?
roles.faqA8: Sammamish backsplashes generally run $1,100 to $2,200 for the typical 30-square-foot kitchen, including outlet cuts, edge trim and grout matched to your counters. Mosaic sheets, herringbone patterns, a framed feature over the range and slab-look full-height panels sit at the high end — the layout and cutting hours, not the tile, put them there.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Frequently, yes — from $8 per square foot. It is the right call for stained or crumbling grout, one or two impact-cracked tiles, or shower corners that need grout swapped for silicone. It is the wrong call when tiles echo hollow underfoot, keep popping in a pattern, or the wall flexes — that is substrate failure, a repair only postpones it, and we will tell you which situation you have before we price anything.
roles.faqQ10: Which Sammamish neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: The whole plateau: Klahanie, Sahalee, Trossachs, Pine Lake, Beaver Lake, Inglewood Hill, Timberline Ridge, Heritage Hill, Aldarra, Montaine, Chestnut Estates, East Lake Sammamish and Providence Point, plus Issaquah Highlands, Redmond Ridge and Fall City next door — and Issaquah, Redmond, Bellevue and the broader Eastside beyond.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Our tile carries a 2-year workmanship warranty — intentionally longer than carpet coverage, since tile trouble tends to appear in the second year, not the second week. Full manufacturer waterproofing assemblies add the maker's own system warranty on top, and the membrane and flood-test photos we keep mean the paper trail exists if the house ever changes hands.
